data.title: Double A reports Q2 2026 revenue of 5.33 billion baht and net profit of 267 million baht

data.title: STA Drives Growth with Highest Q2 Profit in 4 Years, Advances "Empowering AI" Mission
data.description: Sri Trang Agro-Industry Public Company Limited (STA), The world’s largest fully integrated natural rubber enterprise and Thailand’s leading rubber glove manufacture, reported a revenue of THB 31,003.8 million in Q2/2026, up 15.5%, and a net profit of THB 895 million, the highest in 4 years, representing 38.7% increase QoQ. For 6M/2026, the Company recorded revenue of THB 57,845.6 million, with a net profit of THB 1,540.4 million, returning to profit compared with the same period last year. This strong performance was supported by improved profitability across both its natural rubber and rubber glove businesses.

data.title: MDES-depa celebrates success of coding Thailand 2026
data.description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (MDES), through the Digital Economy Promotion Agency (depa), has announced the success of Coding Thailand 2026: AI Inspires the Future, a project aimed at promoting coding and artificial intelligence (AI) skills among Thai students and teachers nationwide. More than 12,000 students and teachers from across the country registered toparticipatein the project. data.title: Shield Insurance Broker Wins Best Customer Experience Initiative in Thailand 2026
data.description: Shield Insurance Broker, operated by Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR), won the Best Customer Experience Initiative in Thailand under the Retail Finance Digital and Frictionless Awards category at The Asian Banker Thailand Awards 2026 . This reflects its success in transforming its role from an insurance broker into a Service Broker. The focus goes beyond selling policies to prioritizing relationship building and continuous customer care throughout the coverage journey. This ranges from pre-purchase consultation, sales, and 24-hour after-sales care, to claim coordination and status tracking. The service model integrates the Shield Insurance Broker Call Center 1501, where a team of experts is on standby 24/7 for emergency coordination, ensuring our customers truly experience peace of mind from purchase to claim."

data.title: Beyond the Magnificent Seven: The Next Wave of AI Investment
data.description: The first phase of the artificial intelligence (AI) investment story belonged to a handful of remarkable companies. Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, Meta and Tesla, the so-called Magnificent Seven, sit at the centre of the most important technology shift in a generation, and the market has rewarded them for it. They now account for roughly a third of the S&P 500, and in 2025 they produced about 42% of the index's total return1. Buy a plain US index fund today and nearly 40 cents of every dollar goes into just 10 companies.
